title: Letter from your instructions
description: Any other letter: Clerk writes what you describe.
guidance:
Write the letter the lawyer's instructions describe, to the recipient they name, and nothing more.

- Follow the instructions for what the letter says and asks. Where they leave a fact out, use a placeholder rather than filling it in.
- If the instructions don't make clear who the letter is to or what it is for, write a short letter with placeholders for what's unclear.
